steps.title: Collect and Store Diatom Samples
steps.instruction: Perform multi-habitat diatoms sampling and preserve the samples in ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Prepare one sterile 50 mL Falcon tube for each sample and label with EtOH resistant labels.
Add 10 mL of diatom sample (e.g., scrape sample) to the Falcon tube.
Add 40 mL of denatured EtOH (96%) to the Falcon tube.
Mix the sample by inverting the Falcon tube.
Store samples under dark conditions at Room temperature or at 4 °C until lysis.

steps.title: Wash Diatom Pellets
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the samples and replace the ethanol to elute pellets.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 50 mL falcon tubes containing the diatom samples at 4000 x g for 10 minutes.
Add 10 mL of fresh denatured EtOH (96%) to each sample in the falcon tube.
Vortex samples to elute pellets again.

steps.title: Prepare Bead Beating Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare 2 mL twist-top tubes with Zirconia beads for mechanical lysis.

substeps.instruction: Add one spoon of 2.0 mm (ca. 10) and 1.0 mm (ca. 30) Zirconia beads to each 2 mL twist-top tube.
Label tubes on both the side and the lid.

steps.title: Transfer Samples to Bead Tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample to the bead tubes using wide-bore or cut tips to prevent clogging.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of sample to each twist-top tube.
Centrifuge samples at 6000 x g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add Lysis Buffer and Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add TNES buffer and Proteinase K to the samples.

substeps.instruction: Add 900 µL of TNES and 100 µL of ProtK to each sample.
Note: TNES and Proteinase K can be prepared as a premix in batches for 24 samples to prevent Proteinase K self-digestion.

steps.title: Incubate and Lyse Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples with agitation to complete lysis.

substeps.instruction: Incubate samples at 55 °C for 20 minutes (00:20:00) at 1400 rpm.

steps.title: Store Lysed Samples
steps.instruction: Store the processed samples at -20 °C until DNA extraction.
